list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl samarium(II) bis(THF) complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, comparison with 2 near Figure 1; Figure S1 referenced
Experimental Section, preparation of 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The structure is reported to be very similar to that of 2, with boratabenzene and fluorenyl rings and two THF donors coordinated to Sm.

synthesis.procedure: A THF solution of K2L was added to SmI2(THF)2 in THF at room temperature. The mixture was stirred overnight, filtered, and concentrated under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; −35 °C for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Extracted the residue with toluene (5 mL) and THF (1 mL), concentrated to about 2 mL, and held at −35 °C to obtain black crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl ytterbium(II) bis(THF) complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 1
Experimental Section, preparation of 2 and shared procedure for 1

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Yb is coordinated by the boratabenzene ring, fluorenyl ring, and two THF molecules in a pseudotetrahedral arrangement.

synthesis.procedure: K2L and YbI2(THF)2 were reacted in THF using the procedure reported for 1.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; −35 °C for crystallization under the shared procedure
synthesis.time: overnight reaction under the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated as red crystals using the filtration, extraction, and low-temperature crystallization procedure reported for 1.

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 2
Experimental Section, preparation of 3

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two ligand units are coupled through fluorenyl carbon atoms to form a trans diboratabenzene bridge between two Yb centers. Each Yb is bound to a boratabenzene ring and a cyclooctatetraenyl dianion in a sandwich arrangement.

synthesis.procedure: A toluene solution of cyclooctatetraene was slowly added to a toluene solution of 2 at room temperature. The mixture was stirred overnight.
synthesis.temperature: room temperature for reaction; −35 °C for crystallization
synthesis.time: overnight reaction; a few days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Removed solvent under vacuum, washed with n-hexane (1 mL twice), extracted with toluene (1.5 mL), and held at −35 °C to obtain green crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Chloride-bridged trinuclear neodymium(III) boratabenzene fluorenyl complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, structures of 4–6 and Figure 3 representative 6
Experimental Section, preparation of 4
Supplied DOI-specific structures catalog row ESEKOE

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article identifies 4 as structurally analogous to 6: a discrete trinuclear lanthanide assembly with three coplanar bridging chlorides and two chloride ligands bridging all three lanthanide centers above and below that plane. The boratabenzene rings bind the lanthanides, while the fluorenyl rings do not coordinate to a metal.

synthesis.procedure: NdCl3 and Li2L were mixed in THF at −35 °C and then stirred at room temperature overnight. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate evaporated under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Washed the residue with n-hexane (2 mL), dissolved it in about 2 mL THF, and slowly introduced n-hexane to obtain red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Chloride-bridged trinuclear samarium(III) boratabenzene fluorenyl complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, structures of 4–6 and Figure 3 representative 6
Experimental Section, preparation of 5 and shared procedure for 4
Supplied DOI-specific structures catalog row ESEKUK

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article reports 5 as structurally similar to the chloride-bridged trinuclear structure illustrated for 6, with three Sm centers in the analogous assembly.

synthesis.procedure: Li2L and SmCl3 were reacted in THF using the preparation and work-up reported for 4.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing; room temperature during stirring under the shared procedure
synthesis.time: overnight reaction under the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Using the procedure for 4, isolated black crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Chloride-bridged trinuclear gadolinium(III) boratabenzene fluorenyl complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 3 and accompanying structural discussion
Experimental Section, preparation of 6 and shared procedure for 4
Supplied DOI-specific structures catalog row ESELAR

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The dianion contains three Gd centers joined by three coplanar doubly bridging chlorides and two triply bridging chlorides above and below their plane. Each Gd also binds a boratabenzene ring and a chloride; the fluorenyl rings are not metal-coordinated. Lithium–THF units and two [Li(THF)4]+ counterions complete the reported assembly.

synthesis.procedure: Li2L and GdCl3 were reacted in THF using the preparation and work-up reported for 4.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing; room temperature during stirring under the shared procedure
synthesis.time: overnight reaction under the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Using the procedure for 4, isolated yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl lanthanum(III) iodide THF complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, structures of 7, 8, and 10 near Figure 4
Experimental Section, preparation of 7

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: La is coordinated by boratabenzene and fluorenyl rings, iodide, and one THF donor in a pseudotetrahedral arrangement.

synthesis.procedure: LaI3(THF)4 and K2L were mixed in THF at −35 °C, stirred at room temperature overnight, filtered, and evaporated under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Washed the oily residue with n-hexane (2 mL) to obtain a yellow solid; single crystals were grown from a THF–toluene mixture.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl neodymium(III) iodide THF complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, structures of 7, 8, and 10 near Figure 4
Experimental Section, preparation of 8

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Nd is coordinated by boratabenzene and fluorenyl rings, iodide, and one THF donor in a pseudotetrahedral arrangement.

synthesis.procedure: NdI3(THF)3.5 and K2L were mixed in THF at −35 °C, stirred at room temperature overnight, filtered, and evaporated under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing and crystallization; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.time: overnight reaction; a few days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Extracted the residue with toluene (3 mL) and held the extract at −35 °C to obtain red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl gadolinium(III) iodide THF complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 4 and accompanying discussion
Experimental Section, preparation of 10 and shared procedure for 8

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Gd is coordinated by boratabenzene and fluorenyl rings, iodide, and one THF donor in a pseudotetrahedral arrangement. The article describes intermediate η3–η5 boratabenzene coordination and η3 fluorenyl coordination.

synthesis.procedure: K2L and GdI3(THF)3.5 were reacted in THF using the procedure reported for 8.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing and crystallization under the shared procedure; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.time: overnight reaction under the shared procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Using the procedure for 8, isolated red crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl lanthanum(III) o-dimethylaminobenzyl THF complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, comparison of 11 with 13a near Figure 5
Experimental Section, preparation of 11

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article reports the structure of 11 as similar to that of the THF-coordinated gadolinium analogue 13a.

synthesis.procedure: Complex 7 and potassium o-dimethylaminobenzyl reagent were mixed in THF at −35 °C and stirred at room temperature overnight. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate evaporated under vacuum.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing and crystallization; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.time: overnight reaction; a few days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Extracted the oily residue with n-hexane (5 mL) and held the extract at −35 °C to obtain a yellow solid.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: THF-coordinated silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl gadolinium(III) o-dimethylaminobenzyl complex

material_class.structural_family: THF-coordinated silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl benzyl complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 5 and comparison with 13b
Experimental Section, joint preparation of 13a and 13b

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The THF-coordinated form has an o-dimethylaminobenzyl ligand bound to Gd. The article describes intermediate η2–η4 boratabenzene coordination and approximately η1–η2 fluorenyl coordination.

synthesis.procedure: Complex 10 and potassium o-dimethylaminobenzyl reagent were mixed in THF at −35 °C and stirred at room temperature overnight. Both 13a and 13b formed in the same preparation.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing and crystallization; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.time: overnight reaction; a few days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, evaporated under vacuum, extracted the oily residue with a THF–n-hexane mixture (5 mL), and held the extract at −35 °C. Yellow crystals of 13a formed together with orange crystals of 13b; the forms could not be completely separated manually.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: THF-free silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl gadolinium(III) o-dimethylaminobenzyl complex

material_class.structural_family: THF-free silicon-bridged boratabenzene fluorenyl benzyl complex

source_locations.location: Results and Discussion, Figure 6 and comparison with 13a
Experimental Section, joint preparation of 13a and 13b

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Unlike 13a, this separately crystallized form has no coordinated THF. The article describes η3–η5 boratabenzene and η5 fluorenyl coordination to Gd.

synthesis.procedure: Complex 10 and potassium o-dimethylaminobenzyl reagent were mixed in THF at −35 °C and stirred at room temperature overnight. Both 13b and 13a formed in the same preparation.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C at mixing and crystallization; room temperature during stirring
synthesis.time: overnight reaction; a few days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, evaporated under vacuum, extracted the oily residue with a THF–n-hexane mixture (5 mL), and held the extract at −35 °C. Orange crystals of 13b formed together with yellow crystals of 13a; the forms could not be completely separated manually.
